candidates.source_name: Gazeta Zyrtare e Republikës së Kosovës — Official Gazette portal (GZK)
candidates.why_relevant: Legally mandated publication venue for all Kosovo laws. The gazette issue number and publication date establish the authoritative start of the entry-into-force / compliance deadline clock for banking and payments statutes. Portal offers advanced search by title, purpose/keywords, content and date range; act-type filters (ligj, kod, dekret, udhëzim administrativ, rregullore, vendim); five language interfaces (sq/en/sr/tr/bs); browse-by-year gazette index; 'Abonohu' subscription and Android/iOS apps.
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Scheduled crawl of the by-year gazette index plus targeted ActDocumentDetail.aspx?ActID=N fetches; parse the header line 'GAZETA ZYRTARE E REPUBLIKËS SË KOSOVËS / Nr. X / DD MUAJ YYYY, PRISHTINË' for issue no. and publication date, and the final 'Hyrja në fuqi' article for the in-force rule. Consider the 'Abonohu' subscription for push notification of new issues.
candidates.discovered_via_method: local-language search (sq) + direct fetch of portal home
queries_used: Gazeta Zyrtare e Republikës së Kosovës ligji për bankat institucionet mikrofinanciare
gzk.rks-gov.net ActDocumentDetail kërkim ligjet gazeta zyrtare zyra ligjore abonimi

candidates.source_name: GZK — LIGJI NR. 04/L-093 për Bankat, Institucionet Mikrofinanciare dhe Institucionet Financiare Jobankare (gazette record)
candidates.why_relevant: The long-standing banking statute record; page header confirms Gazeta Zyrtare Nr. 11 / 11 May 2012. Serves as the baseline anchor against which the 2026 replacement (Law 08/L-304) and its transitional deadlines are measured. Also the parent statute cited in nearly every CBK rregullore.
candidates.suggested_collection_method: One-off baseline fetch; then monitor the GZK act page for amendment/repeal annotations.
queries_used: Gazeta Zyrtare e Republikës së Kosovës ligji për bankat institucionet mikrofinanciare

candidates.source_name: LIGJI NR. 08/L-304 PËR BANKAT — Gazeta Zyrtare Nr. 2 / 27 January 2026 (PDF, CBK-hosted copy)
candidates.why_relevant: The new Kosovo Banking Law as published in the Official Gazette (Nr. 2 / 27 JANAR 2026). This is the single most deadline-relevant statute in the cell: it resets licensing, capital, governance and transitional-compliance clocks for all banks in Kosovo. The gazette header is carried in the PDF itself.
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Fetch PDF, extract gazette header + final transitional/entry-into-force articles; cross-check against the GZK canonical record for the same act.
candidates.discovered_via_method: sq + sr search, snowballed from gazette-header phrasing
queries_used: Presidentja e Kosovës dekret shpallja e ligjit "për bankat" 2026 president-ksgov.net

candidates.source_name: ZAKON BR. 08/L-304 O BANKAMA — Serbian-language gazetted text
candidates.why_relevant: Serbian is an official language of Kosovo and gazette texts are published in it; the Serbian version is the practical reading route for Serb-community institutions and for cross-checking translation of deadline clauses ('stupanje na snagu'). Also the anchor for Serbian-language query expansion in this cell.
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Paired fetch with the Albanian text; diff article numbering to validate translation alignment.
queries_used: Službeni list Republike Kosovo zakon o bankama mikrofinansijskim institucijama stupanje na snagu gzk.rks-gov.net

candidates.source_name: Kuvendi i Kosovës — Projektligjet dhe ligjet (draft laws & laws register)
candidates.why_relevant: The Assembly's legislative register — the upstream half of this cell. Each draft law has a per-item page (pattern: /shq/projektligjet/projektligji/?draftlaw=NNN) carrying sponsor, reading status, committee referral and attached documents. This is where a banking/payments bill becomes visible weeks-to-months before it reaches the gazette.
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Enumerate ?draftlaw=NNN ids with a browser-like user agent / headless browser (plain fetch returned 403); filter titles on sq/sr/en keyword sets (bankat, pagesave, pastrimit të parave, financiar); snapshot reading/committee status per crawl to detect stage transitions.
candidates.discovered_via_method: local-language search (sq), snowballed to per-bill URL pattern
queries_used: Kuvendi i Kosovës projektligji për sistemin e pagesave lexim i parë
kuvendikosoves.org komisioni për ekonomi industri projektligji për bankat 08/L-304 raport me amendamente
candidates.observed_blocker: WebFetch of /shq/projektligjet-dhe-ligjet/ and /shq/projektligjet/projektligji/?draftlaw=266 both returned HTTP 403 Forbidden; pages are indexed by search engines, so treat as bot-defended-but-live, not dead.

candidates.source_name: Kuvendi i Kosovës — English draft-laws register (Draft Laws and Laws)
candidates.why_relevant: English mirror of the bill register, useful for entity resolution and for producing English titles of banking/payments bills without machine translation. Alternate mirror hosts exist (assembly-kosova.org, assemblyofkosovo.org) which may be less bot-defended.
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Crawl in parallel with the sq register; fall back to the assembly-kosova.org / assemblyofkosovo.org mirrors when the primary host 403s.
queries_used: Kosovo Assembly draft law "payment services" 2026 first reading Kuvendi miratoi projektligjin për shërbimet e pagesave

candidates.source_name: Kuvendi i Kosovës — Zakoni / Predlozi zakona (Serbian-language legislative register)
candidates.why_relevant: Serbian-language view of the same bill and law register, satisfying the mandatory sr coverage for the primary-legislation channel and providing the sr title strings ('predlog zakona', 'zakon o ...') needed for query expansion and deduplication.
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Headless-browser crawl mirroring the sq register; use it to harvest sr title variants for entity matching.
queries_used: Skupština Kosova nacrt zakona o bankama srpski kuvendikosoves.org/srb sednica
candidates.observed_blocker: Same host family as the 403-returning sq pages; assumed live.

candidates.source_name: Kuvendi i Kosovës — Seancat (plenary sessions: agendas, order of business, records)
candidates.why_relevant: Plenary agendas ('rendi i ditës') and session records are where first- and second-reading votes on banking/payments bills actually appear with dates. The Presidency sets the order of business at least three days before a sitting, giving a short but real lead indicator that a bill is about to be voted.
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Poll the sessions list twice weekly during plenary weeks (sittings typically twice a month, plenary week starting Thursday; spring session from the third Monday of January, autumn from the second Monday of September); extract agenda items matching the banking/payments glossary.
candidates.discovered_via_method: local-language search (sq/sr) + snowball from Assembly navigation
queries_used: Kuvendi i Kosovës transkriptet seancat plenare rendi i ditës votimi projektligje 2026
candidates.observed_blocker: Not individually fetch-tested; same host previously returned 403 on other paths.

candidates.source_name: Kuvendi i Kosovës — Komisioni për Ekonomi, Industri, Ndërmarrësi dhe Tregti
candidates.why_relevant: Functional committee that reviews economic/financial-sector bills between the two readings and issues the 'raport me amendamente' — the document that reveals what actually changed in a banking or payments bill before it becomes gazetted law. Committee meeting notices give the earliest concrete signal of amendment direction.
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Track committee page + committee news items ('Komisioni për Ekonomi, Industri, Ndërmarrësi dhe Tregti ...') for agenda, meeting minutes and amendment reports; committee id in the ?committee=N query string may shift between legislatures — resolve by name each legislature.
queries_used: kuvendikosoves.org komisioni për ekonomi industri projektligji për bankat 08/L-304 raport me amendamente
candidates.observed_blocker: Committee id numbers observed to vary (46/51 both appear); treat ids as unstable.

candidates.source_name: Kuvendi i Kosovës — Komisioni për Buxhet, Punë dhe Transfere
candidates.why_relevant: Budget/finance committee; the alternative or co-reporting committee for finance-sector bills (CBK law, AML/CFT, deposit insurance, financial-agreement ratifications). Determines which committee a banking bill is referred to, which changes where its amendment report will appear.
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Same crawl pattern as the economy committee; resolve committee by name, not id.
queries_used: kuvendikosoves.org komisioni për ekonomi industri projektligji për bankat 08/L-304 raport me amendamente
local_language_terms_used: Komisioni për Buxhet, Punë dhe Transfere

candidates.source_name: Zyra e Kryeministrit — Projektligji për Shërbimet e Pagesave (government-approved draft text)
candidates.why_relevant: The Draft Law on Payment Services as approved by the Government (8th meeting, Decision No. 08/08, 3 April 2026) and forwarded to the Assembly — the exact text entering the parliamentary pipeline. Highest-value payments item in this cell: it defines payment service provider categories including banks and e-money institutions (incl. branches of foreign EMIs). An earlier 2024 draft of the same law exists, enabling version diffing.
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Crawl kryeministri.rks-gov.net/wp-content/uploads/YYYY/MM/ for PROJEKTLIGJI-*.pdf filenames; diff successive drafts of the same title (2024 vs 2026 versions found) to track scope changes before the Assembly reading.
queries_used: Kuvendi i Kosovës projektligji për sistemin e pagesave lexim i parë

candidates.source_name: Programi i Projektligjeve të Qeverisë (Government legislative programme, multi-year)
candidates.why_relevant: The forward calendar of which draft laws each ministry (notably MFPT — Ministria e Financave, Punës dhe Transfereve — and ZKM) intends to submit and when. This is the single best 6-24 month lead indicator for the banking/payments statute pipeline before any bill exists on the Assembly register. Approved by Government Decision No. 03/247 of 31 January 2025 for 2025-2027.
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Annual fetch of the new programme PDF each Jan-Feb; parse the MFPT and ZKM sections into a planned-legislation table with target quarters; diff year over year for slippage.
queries_used: "Programi Legjislativ" Qeveria e Kosovës 2026 projektligje financiare zyra ligjore kryeministri

candidates.source_name: Platforma e Konsultimeve Publike (konsultimet.rks-gov.net)
candidates.why_relevant: Mandatory pre-parliamentary public consultation platform run by the Office for Good Governance / Prime Minister's Office under Regulation 05/2016 on Minimum Standards for Public Consultation. Draft banking/payments laws appear here with a consultation window and deadline before Government approval — the earliest point at which text and comment deadlines are public. Trilingual (sq/en/sr).
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Enumerate viewConsult.php?ConsultationID=N (ids observed in the 40k-41k range as of 2026); filter titles against the sq/sr/en glossary; capture the consultation open/close dates as deadline events and archive attached draft PDFs.
queries_used: konsultimet.rks-gov.net projektligji pagesave konsultim publik Kosovë

candidates.source_name: Presidentja e Republikës së Kosovës — dekretet e shpalljes së ligjeve (promulgation decrees)
candidates.why_relevant: Constitutionally, a law passed by the Assembly must be decreed/promulgated by the President before gazette publication. The presidency's decree announcements are the last checkpoint between an Assembly vote and the gazette entry, and they name the laws promulgated — a reliable few-days-ahead signal of an imminent gazette publication and therefore of the deadline clock starting.
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Poll the presidency news feed weekly for items containing 'dekretuar shpalljen e ligj'; extract law numbers and match to pending Assembly bills and later gazette issues.
queries_used: Presidentja e Kosovës dekret shpallja e ligjit "për bankat" 2026 president-ksgov.net

candidates.source_name: GZK — LIGJI NR. 03/L-209 për Bankën Qendrore të Republikës së Kosovës (CBK statute record)
candidates.why_relevant: The enabling statute cited as legal basis in essentially every CBK regulation ('Bazuar në nenin 35/36 ... të Ligjit nr. 03/L-209'). Any amendment to it changes the CBK's rule-making authority and therefore the whole downstream regulation stack — a high-leverage statute to watch in the Assembly pipeline.
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Baseline fetch; monitor GZK and the Assembly register for any 'projektligj për ndryshimin dhe plotësimin e Ligjit nr. 03/L-209'.
candidates.discovered_via_method: snowball from CBK regulation preambles citing the statute
queries_used: Presidentja e Kosovës dekret shpallja e ligjit "për bankat" 2026 president-ksgov.net

candidates.source_name: GZK — LIGJI NR. 05/L-096 për Parandalimin e Pastrimit të Parave dhe Luftimin e Financimit të Terrorizmit
candidates.why_relevant: The AML/CFT statute (voted in plenary 25 May 2016, gazetted June 2016) that drives customer due-diligence and reporting obligations for banks, payment institutions and the FIU. AML statutes in Kosovo are amended repeatedly under EU-alignment and MONEYVAL pressure, so this act page is a recurring deadline generator. Predecessor act 03/L-196 also on GZK, useful for lineage.
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Track the GZK act page for amendment notes and the Assembly register for 'projektligj për ndryshimin ... pastrimit të parave'; maintain the lineage 03/L-196 -> 05/L-096 -> successors.

candidates.why_relevant: The incumbent payment-system statute (gazette header: Nr. 12 / 03 MAJ 2013) establishing the CBK as sole authority over Kosovo's payment system. It is the act the incoming Law on Payment Services will amend or displace, so it defines the baseline against which the new compliance deadlines must be read.

Useful as an early-warning pointer to bills before they surface prominently on institutional sites, and for identifying contested provisions.

Provides sr-language naming of bills and decisions, which helps resolve the same act across the sq/sr official texts.

candidates.source_name: Gjykata Kushtetuese e Kosovës — constitutional review of gazetted laws
candidates.why_relevant: A gazetted Kosovo law can be referred to the Constitutional Court by 10+ deputies, which suspends its entry into force pending judgment. That makes the Court a decisive modifier of the compliance-deadline clock this cell exists to track: a gazette date is not a reliable deadline if a referral is pending. Judgments are published in sq/sr/en.
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Monitor the judgments/decisions listing for KO-series case numbers referencing financial-sector laws; link each referral to the corresponding gazette entry and flag its deadline as suspended until judgment.
candidates.discovered_via_method: local-language search (sr) snowball from a KO-case PDF in results

negative_findings.description: Direct WebFetch of the Assembly's own pages returned HTTP 403 Forbidden on two independent paths: https://www.kuvendikosoves.org/shq/projektligjet-dhe-ligjet/ and https://kuvendikosoves.org/shq/projektligjet/projektligji/?draftlaw=266.
negative_findings.result_summary: 403 on both attempts; the same URLs are indexed and summarised by search engines, so the host is almost certainly live and bot-defended rather than dead. Recorded as unverified, not dead.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: The Assembly register is the upstream half of this coverage cell. Any collection design must assume a browser-like client (headless browser or realistic UA/headers), and should keep the assembly-kosova.org / assemblyofkosovo.org mirrors as fallbacks.

negative_findings.description: No structured per-bill stage record (first reading date, second reading date, committee report link) could be confirmed for the banking law 08/L-304 or the Draft Law on Payment Services from search results alone.
negative_findings.result_summary: Searches in sq and en for the 08/L-304 committee amendment report and for a first-reading record of the payment services bill returned no matching Assembly document.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: The reading-stage timeline — the core of the 'when will the deadline clock start' question — is likely only visible inside the 403-blocked per-bill pages, so stage tracking depends entirely on solving the fetch blocker.

negative_findings.description: No RSS/Atom feed, open API, or bulk-download endpoint was identified for either the Official Gazette (gzk.rks-gov.net) or the Assembly bill register.
negative_findings.result_summary: The GZK portal exposes advanced search, by-year browsing, a subscription option and mobile apps, but no documented machine interface was found; the Assembly site likewise showed none in search results.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Ingestion will be scraping-based and therefore fragile to CMS redesigns. The GZK mobile apps are the most promising lead for an undocumented JSON backend and should be investigated before committing to HTML parsing.

negative_findings.description: For the new Law No. 08/L-304 on Banks (Gazette Nr. 2 / 27 January 2026), only the CBK-hosted gazetted PDF (sq and sr) was located; the corresponding gzk.rks-gov.net ActDocumentDetail record was not identified in searches.
negative_findings.result_summary: CBK copies carry the full gazette header, but the canonical GZK ActID for this act remains unknown.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: For a compliance-deadline product, the canonical gazette record should be the citation of record. An ActID resolution step (GZK search by title/number) is a required part of collection design.

negative_findings.description: Serbian-language coverage of the parliamentary stage (as opposed to the final gazetted text) is thin.
negative_findings.result_summary: Serbian searches surfaced the sr register and session pages plus sr gazetted statute PDFs, but no sr-language committee amendment reports or sr per-bill stage pages for banking/payments bills.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: sr is a mandatory language for this run and an official language of Kosovo. If sr-language bill-stage documents genuinely do not exist, that is a structural property of the source landscape that downstream analysis must record rather than treat as a collection failure.

coverage_gaps.description: The Assembly host blocks plain HTTP fetching (403), so per-bill stage metadata cannot currently be collected programmatically.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Build the Assembly collector on a headless browser with realistic headers and polite rate limiting; add assembly-kosova.org and assemblyofkosovo.org as fallback hosts; validate id enumeration ranges for ?draftlaw=N each legislature.

coverage_gaps.description: Committee identifiers in kuvendikosoves.org URLs (?committee=45/46/51) and draft-law ids are opaque and appear to change across legislatures.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Resolve committees and bills by name/number at each crawl rather than persisting numeric ids; store the id only as a per-legislature cache key.

coverage_gaps.description: No confirmed mechanism links an Assembly bill record to its eventual GZK act record (no shared identifier surfaced during discovery).
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Design a matcher keyed on the law number ('08/L-304'), which appears in both the Assembly title and the gazette title, with the presidency promulgation announcement as the bridging event between the vote and the gazette entry.

coverage_gaps.description: Historical legislative-history coverage for pre-2015 banking statutes (04/L-093, 04/L-155, 03/L-209) is scattered across the legacy Assembly site and may be incomplete.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Run a one-off harvest of old.kuvendikosoves.org and of GZK by-year indices to build a historical first-reading-to-gazette duration baseline for financial-sector bills.

coverage_gaps.description: Turkish and Bosnian gazette language versions exist on the GZK portal but were not explored in this run (out of the declared sq/sr/en scope).
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Note as available-but-unused; only worth adding if downstream consumers need tr/bs texts.

coverage_gaps.description: The sponsoring ministry's own legal-drafting output (MFPT — Ministria e Financave, Punës dhe Transfereve) was reached only indirectly via the PM Office uploads and the legislative programme; the ministry's own legislation page was not separately located.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Add a targeted scout pass on the MFPT website for its legislation / draft-acts section and its concept documents ('koncept dokument'), which precede draft laws in the Kosovo drafting process.

brief: Kosovo's primary-legislation channel for banking and payments is a well-defined four-stage pipeline with a distinct public source at each stage: concept/draft text on the Public Consultation Platform (konsultimet.rks-gov.net) and the Prime Minister's Office uploads, planned timing in the multi-year Programi i Projektligjeve të Qeverisë, parliamentary stage on the Kuvendi i Kosovës bill register plus its economy and budget committees and plenary session records, and finally presidential promulgation followed by authoritative publication in Gazeta Zyrtare (gzk.rks-gov.net), whose issue number and date start the compliance clock. The channel is currently live and moving: Law No. 08/L-304 on Banks was gazetted in Nr. 2 / 27 January 2026 (replacing the 2012 Law 04/L-093), and a Draft Law on Payment Services was approved by Government on 3 April 2026 and is heading to the Assembly to displace the 2013 Law 04/L-155 on the Payment System. The main collection risk is access rather than availability: the Assembly host returned HTTP 403 to plain fetches (bot-defended, not dead) and neither the gazette nor the Assembly exposes a documented feed or API, so a headless-browser collector with mirror-host fallbacks and law-number-based linkage between bill and gazette records is required. Constitutional Court referrals should be tracked as a modifier, since a referral suspends a gazetted law's entry into force and invalidates a naive deadline computed from the gazette date alone.
